summary: 周六较安静。Sigma Prime 重申 Glamsterdam 将于 10 月 6 日 13:53:36 UTC 在 Sepolia 激活。Magicians 出现一个讨论“计算与证据不等于授权”的 Resolution 草案，ethresear.ch 有人复盘一个签名验证工具中找到的六个缺陷。

items.title: Magicians：EIP-TBD: Resolution, Non-Self-Authorizing State Transitions
items.note: 11:37 发布（作者 chugarchugarr），当天有 11 帖。它把恢复、代理（agent）、溯源、裁决等场景里的共同边界抽出来：候选转换、证据、可采纳性、授权、决议、后继状态，每一步都是单独的转换。不变量是：后继状态拥有的授权不能多于由已采纳证据、既定流程和当前授权状态能推出的授权。
items.title_en: Magicians: EIP-TBD: Resolution, Non-Self-Authorizing State Transitions
items.note_en: Posted at 11:37 by chugarchugarr, reached 11 posts the same day. It pulls out a boundary shared by recovery, agents, provenance and adjudication: candidate transition, evidence, admissibility, authority, resolution and successor state, each a separate step. The invariant is that no successor state may hold more authority than can be derived from the admitted evidence, the committed procedure and the current authority state.

items.note_en: 00:19. The author wrote down predictions before each round so they could not grade themselves afterwards. The takeaway for users: a verification tool returning success does not mean anything was verified.

summary_en: A quiet Saturday. Sigma Prime restated that Glamsterdam activates on Sepolia at 13:53:36 UTC on October 6. A Resolution draft on Magicians argues that computation and evidence do not imply authority, and an ethresear.ch post walks through six defects found in one signature verification tool.
